title: Canonsburg-Houston, Pennsylvania, Local Protection Project (LPP) PL84-99 Rehabilitation
description: PRESOLICITATION NOTICE DISCLAIMER: This document is issued solely for informational and planning purposes as a Presolicitation Notice and does not constitute a Request for Quotation (RFQ), or a promise to issue an award or solicitation in the future. The information and requirements outlined herein are subject to change. Specifications, drawings, schedules, wage rate determinations, and solicitation instructions will be provided upon the official posting of the formal RFQ. 1. Project Overview & Background The Canonsburg-Houston Local Protection Project (LPP) is an authorized federal flood damage reduction project spanning over 20,500 linear feet of channel improvements along Chartiers Creek. Originally constructed by USACE in two phases (Houston unit completed in 1970; Canonsburg unit completed in 1976), operation and maintenance responsibilities were subsequently transferred to Washington County. Severe storm events resulted in substantial damage to the channel embankment along the right bank of Chartiers Creek, including displacement of stone protection and loss of subgrade stabilization. This rehabilitation contract encompasses repair and re-armoring of the degraded channel reach to restore federal project integrity and design conveyance capacity. The Anticipated Cost of Construction is between $150,000.00 and $300,000.00. The project is to be completed within 120 Calendar Days after written Notice to Proceed (NTP). 2. Technical Scope of Work & Execution Limits The contractor must furnish all management, supervision, labor, heavy equipment, materials, water control, and environmental controls necessary to execute the repairs. Repair Reach Limits: Repair work is concentrated along the right bank of Chartiers Creek between approximate stations STA 164+00 and STA 166+50. Site Access & Clearing: Access to the creek channel will be achieved from the left bank access ramp near STA 163+00. The ramp requires clearing of dense brush and vegetation in strict accordance with PennDOT Publication 408, Section 201. Geotextile Underlayment: Existing geotextiles within the damage limits are assumed damaged and must be excavated and replaced. The contractor must furnish and place Class 4, Type A non-woven geotextile fabric conforming to PennDOT 408 Section 735. Panels must be placed over prepared, compacted subgrade with a minimum 18-inch overlap, placing upstream panels over downstream panels. Stone Protection (R-5 Riprap): Riprap protection will be restored using PennDOT R-5 stone (minimum 1�-6� layer thickness) conforming to PennDOT 408 Section 850 and ASTM D5519. Stones must be placed with zero free fall and a maximum drop height not exceeding 12 inches to prevent fabric puncturing and stone segregation. Hand or mechanical rearrangement is required to achieve a dense, evenly graded mass free of stone clusters or void pockets. Temporary Water Diversion & Dewatering: In-channel work must be performed in completely dewatered conditions. The contractor is responsible for the complete engineering, installation, continuous pumping/diversion, maintenance, and final removal of a temporary water diversion system. All pumped effluent must pass through certified sediment/debris control devices prior to discharge back into the creek. Removed streambed material must be stockpiled and replaced upon completion. Demolition & Waste Disposal: Damaged geotextile, dead vegetative matter, and unserviceable excavated fill must be excavated, loaded, and disposed of off-site at a commercially permitted landfill or recycling facility in accordance with PADEP 258-2182-773 (Management of Fill). 3. Key Personnel & Qualification Thresholds On-site supervisory staff must satisfy strict USACE qualifications and maintain designated physical presence: Project Superintendent: Minimum of 5 years of construction experience, including at least 5 years serving as superintendent on comparable earthwork and channel restoration projects. Must possess demonstrated proficiency in USACE EM 385-1-1 safety compliance and hazard mitigation. Dedicated role; cannot serve concurrently as the QCSM or SSHO. Contractor Quality Control System Manager (QCSM): Minimum of 5 years of construction experience on similar stream restoration and civil earthwork projects. Must be directly employed by the prime contractor and hold a valid Construction Quality Management for Contractors (CQM-C) certification issued by USACE/NAVFAC. Required to be on site at all times during construction activities. Site Safety and Health Officer (SSHO): Must meet Level 1 SSHO qualifications outlined in EM 385-1-1 (2024 edition) and be formally designated via ENG Form 6282. Full-time responsibility reporting directly to a corporate officer; must be on-site whenever active operations occur. Dual-Hat Allowance: The SSHO may concurrently serve as the QCSM (provided all CQM-C requirements are satisfied) but cannot serve as the Project Superintendent. Safety Compliance: Safety Compliance (EM 385-1-1): Offerors are advised that all work on this project must strictly comply with the latest edition of the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) Safety and Health Requirements Manual (EM 385-1-1) (Link: https://www.publications.usace.army.mil/Portals/76/EM%20385-1-1%20_EFFECTIVE%2015March2024.pdf). Prior to commencing work, the contractor must submit and secure Government approval for a site-specific Accident Prevention Plan (APP) and comprehensive Activity Hazard Analyses (AHAs). 4. Key Performance Constraints & Operational Rules 25-Foot Embankment Exposure Limit: To prevent catastrophic washout during sudden high streamflows, the contractor must limit stripped subgrade or exposed geotextile fabric to maximum 25-foot linear sections, or lengths that can be fully backfilled and armored with R-5 riprap within the same working shift. Embankments covered solely by geotextile fabric are formally classified as unprotected. NWS Weather Monitoring & High-Water Action Thresholds: The contractor must continuously monitor National Weather Service (NWS) hydrologic forecasts for the Chartiers Creek tributary basin. Upon the issuance of any NWS Flash Flood Watch or Flash Flood Warning, all in-channel operations must be immediately suspended, equipment evacuated to high ground, and incremental work secured. Protection of Incremental Work: Work must be sequenced so that initiated features can be completed, stabilized, or protected prior to forecasted high-water events. Any equipment, materials, or partially installed work damaged by stream currents or inadequate water diversion must be replaced at the contractor�s expense. 5. General Information The North American Industrial Classification Code (NAICS) is 237990 � Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction. The Small Business Size Standard is $45,000,000.00. Any resultant award will be for one (1) Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) Purchase Order. The solicitation will be issued on or about 9 October 2026, via the Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE), which posts the opportunity to SAM.gov. The anticipated award date is 13 November 2026. The basis of award will be of best value to the Government. Basis of Award is best value to the Government. Quotes will be evaluated in accordance with (IAW) RFO 12.203(a), price and past performance. The Government reserves the right to reject any quotes that are unrealistically low or exceed available funds for this requirement. Small businesses are strongly encouraged to connect with their local APEX Accelerators to leverage these valuable services. The APEX Accelerators Website is: https://www.apexaccelerators.us/#/. title: Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) Infrastructure Standards Development, Maintenance, and Related Activities
description: This notice is issued by the U.S. Department of Transportation (USDOT), Federal Highway Administration (FHWA), O?ice of Acquisition and Grants Management. Pursuant to 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(3), as implemented by FAR 6.302-3(a)(2)(ii) (Establishing or maintaining essential engineering, research, or development capability specifically provided by an educational or other nonprofit institution or a federally funded research and development center) and FAR 6.302-3(b)(2)(ii) (Establishing or maintaining an essential capability for engineering or developmental work calling for the practical application of investigative findings and theories of a scientific or technical nature), the Government intends to negotiate and award a single-award, Indefinite-Delivery Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) contract to: Institute of Transportation Engineers (ITE), Inc. 1627 Eye Street NW Suite 600 Washington, DC 20006 The Institute of Transportation Engineers (ITE) is a professional association and recognized standards development organization with a long-standing role in supporting the development, maintenance, and stewardship of national Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) standards in coordination with the U.S. Department of Transportation, Federal Highway Administration (FHWA) and the ITS Joint Program Office. For over three decades, ITE has supported federally stewarded ITS standards activities that bring together public agencies, private-sector technology providers, and subject matter experts to develop consensus-based standards that enable interoperable, safe, and effective transportation systems. FHWA requires non-personal systems engineering development, testing, and research services to support the U.S. Department of Transportation, Federal Highway Administration (FHWA) ITS Joint Program Office (ITS-JPO).

title: Tactical Data Link (TDL) Interoperability Software
description: Air Combat Command's (ACC) mission requires robust Tactical Datalink (TDL) interoperability to improve mission effectiveness for United States Air Force (USAF), Joint, and coalition forces. To support this mission, the Government requires a modern software solution that serves as a relational database and analysis toolset. This toolset is essential for the iSMART (interoperable Systems Management and Requirements Transformation) process and is used to populate, edit, analyze, and manage TDL message data, platform implementations, and interoperability evaluations. The Contractor shall provide an existing commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) software solution, including all necessary licenses, updates, training, and technical support. The software shall provide a comprehensive toolset for managing TDL platform specifications, conducting interoperability analysis, and supporting mission planning across the TDL enterprise. The TDL software solution must meet all requirements as listed in the Attachment 1 - Performance Work Statement.

title: ETHEREAL FORGE: Call for Participation � Test & Evaluation of Advanced Electromagnetic Warfare (EW) Capabilities
description: Overall objective: Test and evaluate Modular Open Systems Approach (MOSA)-conformant, modular, advanced Electromagnetic Warfare (EW) capabilities against realistic threats in a representative environment to assess capability utility, inform the development and acquisitions processes, and gain insight to support rapid, iterative fielding of Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations (EMSO) capabilities. The objective is to be a forcing function to drive towards the next generation of modular, rapidly upgradeable EMSO systems that will sense the electromagnetic environment, make sense of it, maneuver within it, and engage with precision at the speed of light. Background: Many promising EW capabilities are being developed based on modular hardware- and software-centric principles linked to mature open standards, such as SOSA, CMOSS, FACE, VITA, and/or AMS-GRA. These capabilities require demonstration in a representative environment before being accepted by program offices for final integration. This event will leverage lessons learned from multiple pathfinding events, experiments, and exercises over the past six years. Expected outcomes: Technology Readiness Assessments of the suitability for further integration and fielding of candidate capabilities (specifically software applications and SOSA hardware components) Key data to support future budgeting cycles and acquisition processes Data-centric assessments to inform mission- and campaign-level simulations, directly supporting long-term planning and acquisitions cycles Prototype infrastructure and process to accelerate test and evaluation of modular hardware components and software-defined capabilities

title: India Navy Multi-Role Helicopter Follow On Sustainment

The modification will include follow-on sustainment for Software IN28 and development of the IN30 Configuration, Retrofit labor and Material, program management, in-country Field Service Representative (FSR) support, and over-and-above labor as well as flight test support. The Software IN30 Configuration effort includes continued development, integration, testing, documentation, and support necessary to complete and sustain the India-specific MH-60R IN30 configuration. The projected period of performance for this modification is 2027-2031. This action is intended to be awarded on a sole-source basis to LM RMS under the authority permitting other than full and open competition, Title 10, U.S.C. 3204(a)(1), as implemented by FAR 6.302-1, �Only One Responsible Source and No Other Type of Supplies or Services Will Satisfy Agency Requirements.� LM RMS is the original equipment manufacturer, designer, developer, and systems integrator for the MH-60R aircraft and associated weapon system. LM RMS is the only responsible source with the requisite technical knowledge, proprietary technical data, specialized facilities, test equipment, experience, and qualified personnel necessary to provide the required follow-on support and maintain configuration control of the India MH-60R IN30 system configuration without unacceptable cost, schedule, or technical risk. Note: This notice of intent is not a request for competitive proposals. The proposed contract action is for supplies or services for which the Government intends to solicit and negotiate with only one source under the authority of FAR 6.302-1. The Government does not intend to fund the development or qualification of other sources to fulfill this requirement. However, the Government will consider all capability statements received within thirty days after publication of this synopsis. A determination by the Government not to compete this proposed action based upon responses to this notice is solely within the discretion of the Government. title: REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI)/ SOURCES SOUGHT Space Force Mission Delta 9 (MD9) � SL-5 EC2-S Ground System Sustainment
description: DESCRIPTION: MD 9 is seeking market research information for an enterprise Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) in accordance with DFARS 212.70, Defense Commercial Solutions Opening. The goal is to enhance MD 9�s operational capabilities through innovative commercial solutions to acquire innovative commercial products, technologies, or services. Headquarters is located at Schriever Space Force Base, Colorado, and is the United States Space Force's designated orbital warfare organization. Its core purpose is to guarantee the United States, and its allies have undisputed freedom of action in space. The mission of MD9 is to prepare, present, and project assigned and attached forces for the purpose of conducting protect and defend operations while providing national decision authorities with response options to deter and, when necessary, defeat orbital threats. Additionally, MD9 supports Space Domain Awareness by conducting space-based battlespace characterization operations and conducts on-orbit experimentation and technology demonstrations for the USSF. To achieve this, MD 9 is comprised of specialized units, including space operations squadrons responsible for on-orbit engagements, while also being supported by dedicated cyber, intelligence, and sustainment squadrons that ensure the availability, reliability, security, and effectiveness of its mission systems. RFI and/or Sources Sought: The Government is conducting market research to inform an enterprise acquisition strategy for the Mission Delta 9 (MD9) effort. This effort is intended to support the full MD9 enterprise and is not limited to a single Area of Interest (AOI) or specific requirement. Individual AOIs may involve varying security levels and access requirements based on their respective operational, technical, and acquisition considerations. At this time, the Government is requesting: Review and inputs on the unclassified enterprise Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) Completion of the Initial Intake RFI Questionnaire; and Submission of an unclassified Capability Statement from all interested organizations. Completion of the questionnaire is necessary to obtain sufficient market-research information and assess the number of industry partners capable of responding to various AOIs that may be issued at differing security levels. The anticipated effort includes support at multiple locations, including Kirtland Air Force Base, New Mexico This RFI/Sources Sought Information request has been reaccomplished to capture adequate information from Industry. If you have submitted a capability statement already, you are not required to resubmit. 22 Sep 2026 Overhaul of the RFI/Sources Sought Information effort. Released the Draft enterprise CSO for review. Please provide responses by 11 Oct 2026. DISCLAIMER & IMPORTANT NOTES: This RFI is issued solely for information and planning purposes and does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP) or a promise to issue an RFP in the future. This RFI does not commit the US Government to contract for any supply or service whatsoever. All costs associated with responding to this RFI will be solely at the interested party�s expense. Not responding to this RFI does not preclude participation in any future RFP, if any is issued. All submissions will become Government property and will not be returned.

title: Hydraulic Press Small Arms Demilitarization System �Commodore Crunch� Maintenance and Repair Services in Anniston, Alabama
description: DLA Disposition Services intends to award a sole source contract according to FAR Part 6 and FAR Part 12 to CNC Solutions LLC (CAGE: JTR6). The acquisition is pursued according to procedures in FAR 6.103-1(b), 12.102(b) and 12.201-1. The services for this contract will provide critical preventative maintenance and correct maintenance to the Commodore Crunch system to demilitarize Department of War excess property. Due to the high customization, expertise, and experience of maintaining this equipment, DLA Disposition Services is conducting a sole source action to award this contract to CNC Solutions to perform the maintenance services. Maintenance services are required for the Hydraulic Press Small Arms Demilitarization System, informally known as �Commodore Crunch.� The Hydraulic Press is necessary for demilitarization functions at DLA DS Anniston site. Hydraulic Press operability is imperative to the site�s mission to prevent backlog of material requiring demilitarization. The Contractor shall troubleshoot, diagnose, provide scheduled maintenance, obtain parts, and repair the hydraulic press. The maintenance / repair of this highly specialized equipment is deemed to be available only from the original source, CNC Solutions. Acquisition planning supports this is a sole source requirement. The Government intends to solicit and negotiate with only one source under the authority of FAR [RFO] 12.102(b). This proposed contract will be a Sole Source acquisition under NAICS code 811310 with a size standard of $12.5M. The Justification and Approval (J&A) is attached to this posting [Attachment 1]. The J&A was prepared according to FAR 6.104. This notice of intent is not a request for competitive quotations. A solicitation document will not be issued, and quotes will not be requested. All Federal Acquisition Regulation references in this notice are according to the FAR Overhaul [RFO].

title: Romania – Non-hazardous refuse and waste treatment and disposal services – DELEGAREA GESTIUNII ACTIVITĂȚILOR COMPONENTE ALE SERVICIULUI DE SALUBRIZARE PRIVIND TRATAREA MECANO-BIOLOGICĂ ȘI ELIMINAREA PRIN DEPOZITARE A DEȘEURILOR MUNICIPALE, ÎN JUDEȚUL MUREȘ
description: Obiectul prezentei proceduri îl reprezintă atribuirea unui contract de concesiune de servicii pentru delegarea gestiunii activităților componente ale Serviciului de Salubrizare privind tratarea mecano-biologică și eliminarea prin depozitare a deșeurilor municipale, în județul Mureș. Activitățile principale ale Contractului sunt: (i) Tratarea mecano-biologică a deșeurilor reziduale; (ii) Transportul deșeurilor stabilizate biologic și al deșeurilor reziduale care nu mai pot fi valorificate la DDN Sânpaul; (iii) Transportul deșeurilor reziduale valorificabile energetic la instalațiile de valorificare energetică; (iv) Eliminarea prin depozitare a deșeurilor reziduale, a deșeurilor stradale, a deșeurilor de pământ și pietre provenite de pe căile publice, a reziduurilor rezultate de la SSCT Cristești, TMB Sânpaul și STZ-uri, precum și a deșeurilor care nu pot fi valorificate provenite din activități de reamenajare și reabilitare interioară și/sau exterioară a locuințelor la Depozitul de Deșeuri Nepericuloase de la Sânpaul. Activitățiile secundare (conexe) ale Contractului sunt: (i) Realizarea proiectului tehnic de execuție pentru construirea Celulei nr. 2 pe amplasamentul DDN Sânpaul; (ii) Realizarea documentației de avizare a lucrărilor de intervenții, inclusiv studii specifice necesare pentru retehnologizarea STMB Sânpaul; (iii) Realizarea proiectului tehnic de execuție pentru retehnologizarea STMB Sânpaul; (iv) Obținerea tuturor avizelor/acordurilor/autorizațiilor necesare pentru autorizarea lucrărilor de construcții și montaj pentru cele două infrastructuri: DDN și STMB; (v) Execuția lucrărilor de construire a Celulei nr. 2 pe amplasamentul DDN Sânpaul; (vi) Furnizarea utilajelor și echipamentelor industriale necesare conform Listelor de investiții (Anexa 3 și Anexa 5 la Caietul de sarcini) inclusiv montajul acestora pe amplasament; (vii) Asistență tehnică din partea echipei/echipelor de proiectare pe tot parcursul realizării investițiilor la cele două infrastructuri; (viii) Închiderea Celulei nr. 1 la epuizarea capacității de depozitare conform Proiectului tehnic de închidere pus la dispoziție în Anexa 6 la Caietul de sarcini; (ix) Închiderea Celulei nr. 2 la epuizarea capacității de depozitare conform Proiectului tehnic de închidere pus la dispoziție de Consiliul Județean Mureș la atingerea capacității de depozitare de 75% în celula nr. 2. Notă: a) termenul până la care operatorii economici pot transmite solicitările de clarificări/informațiile suplimentare cum s-a menționat la Secțiunea I.3 este de 25 zile înanite de data limită de depunere a ofertelor b) termenul limită de răspuns al Autorității Contractante la solicitările de clarificări primite în termenul menționat mai sus este de 15 zile înainte de data limită de depunere a ofertelor.

title: Germany – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Grundhafte Erneuerung von drei innerörtlichen Straßen (Liederbach)
description: Zur Verbesserung der örtlichen Verkehrsinfrastruktur plant die Stadt Alsfeld die grundhafte Erneuerung der Merschroder Straße sowie die Sanierung bzw. Erneuerung des Brückenbauwerks über den Liederbach. Für die gemeindeeigene Straße In der Hohl sind je nach Ausbauabschnitt entweder eine grundhafte Erneuerung oder ein erstmaliger Ausbau vorgesehen. Auf Grundlage des vorhandenen baulichen Zustands besteht in allen zwei Straßenbereichen ein erheblicher Erneuerungsbedarf. Darüber hinaus ist der Straßenendausbau der Straße Hainberg geplant. Die Merschroder Straße weist deutliche Schäden an der Fahrbahnoberfläche in Form von Rissen, Setzungen und Unebenheiten auf. Auch die Gehwege, Nebenanlagen sowie die vorhandenen Entwässerungseinrichtungen entsprechen nicht mehr den aktuellen funktionalen und barrierefreien Anforderungen. Die Straße In der Hohl befindet sich ebenfalls in einem stark sanierungsbedürftigen Zustand und zudem noch nicht vollständig ausgebaut. Da die Straße Hainberg derzeit noch keinen endgültigen Ausbauzustand aufweist, soll sie im Zuge der Maßnahme vollständig ausgebaut werden. Ein weiterer Bestandteil der Maßnahme ist die Erneuerung des Plattenbrückenbauwerks, die sich im südlichen Abschnitt der Merschroder Straße befindet und die über den Liederbach führt. Das Ingenieurbauwerk weist alters- und nutzungsbedingte Defizite im Über- sowie Unterbau auf und soll im Zuge der Gesamtmaßnahme planerisch berücksichtigt sowie je nach Untersuchungsergebnis erneuert oder ertüchtigt werden.

title: Germany – Preservation services of exhibits – Stiftung Schloss Marienburg: Vergabe von Restaurierungsleistungen im Rahmen der Umsetzung des Masterplans MB2030
description: Das Projekt "Marienburg 2030" startete im Jahr 2020 mit dem Ziel, Schloss Marienburg als öffentliches Museum zu nutzen. Ausgangspunkt war der Übergang der geschichtsträchtigen Immobilie und des historischen Inventars aus dem Privatbesitz des Hauses Hannover in die Stiftung Schloss Marienburg. Damit verbunden ist die Verpflichtung, das kulturelle Erbe dauerhaft für die Öffentlichkeit zugänglich zu machen, es wissenschaftlich zu erschließen und denkmalgerecht zu erhalten. Mit der Ausarbeitung einer entsprechenden Machbarkeitsstudie erfolgte die Erfassung des umfangreichen Kulturguts und die notwendigen kuratorischen sowie restauratorischen Grundstrukturen für den zukünftigen Museumsbetrieb. Nach dem positiven Ergebnis dieser Vorstudie startete im Jahr 2022 die interdisziplinäre Ausarbeitung eines detaillierten Masterplans. Das Herzstück dieses Museumskonzepts bildet ein abwechslungsreicher und informativer Rundgang durch die historischen Schlossräume. Für die Umsetzung dieses Konzepts stellt der Beauftragte für Kultur und Medien der Bundesregierung (BKM) und das Land Niedersachsen Mittel für die Restaurierung der zukünftigen Exponate zur Verfügung. Hierdurch ist es der Stiftung Schloss Marienburg möglich, Konservierungs- und Restaurierungsleistungen für die ersten 45 zukünftigen Ausstellungsstücke aufgeteilt in 17 Lose auszuschreiben.(siehe Anlage 1 Lose 01-17 der Vergabeunterlagen). Im Rahmen der Erhaltung und Sicherung von Kunst- und Kulturgütern sollen nunmehr die Restaurierungsleistungen vergeben werden. Gegenstand der Leistung sind insbesondere konservatorische Sicherung und ggf. erforderliche restauratorische Maßnahmen.

Netherlands – Refuse recycling services – Verwerking van Groente, Fruit en Tuinafval (GFT)
description: Deze uitnodiging tot inschrijving betreft de aanbesteding van de verwerking van huishoudelijk Groente, Fruit en Tuinafval (GFT) van circa 40 gemeenten. Coöperatieve Vereniging Midwaste Milieu U.A. (Midwaste) is de aanbestedende dienst en zal in het te vormen contract de Opdrachtgever zijn namens acht van haar leden en de circa 40 gemeenten die daarmee worden vertegenwoordigd. In totaal gaat het om circa 175kton aan huishoudelijk GFT per jaar. Het totale volume afval is verdeeld over 10 percelen waarvoor Midwaste meerdere verwerkers zoekt. De percelen kennen een initiële looptijd van circa 2-8 jaar met een tweetal verlengingsopties. De percelen kennen andere einddata. De aanbesteding maakt gebruik van een gunningsmethodiek van prijs en duurzaamheid in de vorm van CO2 equivalenten waar een fictieve waarde aan wordt toegekend. Overslag van het GFT en Transport naar de verwerkingslocatie maakt geen onderdeel uit van de opdracht.

title: Netherlands – Advertising and marketing services – Arbeidsmarktcommunicatie en Mediadiensten
description: De Opdracht omvat dienstverlening op het gebied van arbeidsmarktcommunicatie, employer branding, mediastrategie, mediaplanning, media-inkoop en media-administratie (waaronder ook beheer) voor betaalde media. Opdrachtnemer voert deze werkzaamheden uit voor (arbeidsmarkt)campagnes en losse plaatsingen van de Politie. De mediaplaatsingen vinden hoofdzakelijk plaats in Nederlandse media, maar de Politie heeft met betrekking tot opsporingscommunicatie ook behoefte aan plaatsingen in buitenlandse media (voornamelijk binnen Europa). Arbeidsmarktcommunicatie heeft als doel het positioneren van de Politie als aantrekkelijke werkgever en opleider ten behoeve van de werving van voldoende agenten, bedrijfsvoeringsfuncties en diverse andere (specialistische) politiefuncties. Om dat te bereiken ontwikkelt de Politie samen met de Opdrachtnemer voor arbeidsmarktcommunicatie onder andere wervingscampagnes. Om deze campagnes op het juiste moment bij de juiste doelgroepen te laten landen werkt de Opdrachtnemer voor arbeidsmarkt-communicatie intensief samen met de Opdrachtnemer voor mediadiensten. Het mediabureau adviseert over de in te zetten media, heeft kennis van mediagedrag van uiteenlopende doelgroepen, monitort de prestaties van de ingezette campagne-uitingen en stemt dit weer af met de Politie of met het arbeidsmarktcommunicatiebureau om daarmee de campagnes te optimaliseren.

title: Netherlands – Boxes – Raamovereenkomst handelsgebruikelijke verpakkingsmaterialen
description: Het Ministerie van Defensie maakt voor haar dagelijkse bedrijfsvoering gebruik van diverse handelsgebruikelijke verpakkingsmaterialen. Deze verpakkingsmiddelen worden toegepast voor het verpakken, beschermen, opslaan en transporteren van goederen binnen het Ministerie van Defensie.Om te voorzien in de structurele behoefte aan deze verpakkingsmaterialen wenst de Aanbestedende dienst een raamovereenkomst te sluiten met één leverancier. Binnen deze raamovereenkomst kunnen verschillende onderdelen van het Ministerie van Defensie gedurende de looptijd van de raamovereenkomst verpakkingsmaterialen afroepen. Met deze aanbesteding beoogt de Aanbestedende dienst te komen tot een efficiënte en eenduidige wijze van inkoop van handelsgebruikelijke verpakkingsmaterialen, waarbij standaardisatie, leveringszekerheid en administratieve eenvoud worden bevorderd.

description: Deze aanbesteding betreft de uitvoering van postdiensten voor de Bedrijfsvoeringsorganisatie West-Betuwe (BWB) en haar deelnemende organisaties (Gemeente Culemborg, Gemeente Tiel, Gemeente West Betuwe) en Omgevingsdienst Rivierenland. title: Netherlands – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Vervanging Document Management Systeem (DMS)
description: De Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA) en de Hogeschool van Amsterdam (HvA) zijn voornemens gezamenlijk een nieuw Document Management Systeem (DMS) aan te schaffen ter vervanging van het huidige DMS. Het doel van de aanbesteding is het contracteren van een toekomstbestendige, veilige en gebruiksvriendelijke DMS-oplossing die de UvA en HvA ondersteunt bij het duurzaam beheren, toegankelijk maken en archiveren van digitale documenten en dossiers. De opdracht omvat onder meer de levering van de DMS-oplossing, implementatie en configuratie, migratie van bestaande documenten, metadata en dossiers, integraties met de bestaande IT-omgeving, opleidingen en kennisoverdracht, beheer, onderhoud, ondersteuning en doorontwikkeling. De aangeboden oplossing dient aan te sluiten op de bestaande informatievoorziening van de UvA en HvA en onder meer ondersteuning te bieden voor document- en dossierbeheer, metadata, workflows, autorisatie, bewaartermijnen, archivering, vernietiging, zoeken, audittrail en integraties met de bestaande Microsoft 365-omgeving. Bij de beoordeling wordt naast de kwaliteit van de aangeboden oplossing en dienstverlening onder meer gekeken naar de implementatie- en migratieaanpak, toekomstbestendigheid, security en compliance en gebruikerservaring, adoptie en zelfredzaamheid. De prijs vormt eveneens onderdeel van de beoordeling. Als onderdeel van de gunningsprocedure worden verplichte demonstraties georganiseerd waarin de inschrijvers de aangeboden oplossing aan de hand van verschillende praktijksituaties demonstreren. De opdracht wordt gegund aan de inschrijver met de economisch meest voordelige inschrijving op basis van de beste prijs-kwaliteitverhouding (BPKV).

title: Netherlands – Blood-testing reagents – Levering en implementatie van en onderhoud aan een gevalideerde Totaaloplossing voor de SCID- en SMA-screening ten behoeve van meerdere laboratoria
description: De neonatale hielprikscreening (NHS) is een landelijk screeningsprogramma dat wordt uitgevoerd bij pasgeborenen in de eerste week na de geboorte. In Nederland (Europees en Caribisch Nederland) krijgen jaarlijks ca. 170.000 pasgeborenen de hielprik. De hielprikscreening is het langstlopende landelijke screeningsprogramma in de publieke gezondheidszorg. De analyse van het hielprikbloed levert op dit moment belangrijke informatie op over zevenentwintig zeldzame, vaak erfelijke, ernstige aandoeningen. Het bloedonderzoek wordt vanaf 2026 verricht door drie screeningslaboratoria, waarvan het screeningslaboratorium van RIVM-GZB fungeert als referentielaboratorium. De screeningslaboratoria zijn verantwoordelijk voor de analyse van het hielprikbloedmonster en een tijdige rapportage van de uitslag. In alle screeningslaboratoria wordt vanaf januari 2021 onder meer gebruik gemaakt van een Totaaloplossing voor de screening op SCID. Vanaf 1 juni 2022 is ook SMA toegevoegd aan het programma en screenen de laboratoria met een multiplex Totaaloplossing waarmee zowel op SCID als SMA gescreend kan worden. Daarnaast bestaat de mogelijkheid dat in de komende jaren besloten wordt dat op X-gebonden Agammaglobulinemie (XLA) gescreend moet gaan worden. Om de uniformiteit te borgen heeft het RIVM besloten om de apparaten (hardware), software, reagentia en bijbehorend onderhoud (preventief, correctief, adaptief), ook wel Totaaloplossing genoemd, in te kopen en ter beschikking te stellen aan de screeningslaboratoria. Deze Aanbestedingsprocedure betreft een opdracht voor de levering, implementatie en onderhoud van een gevalideerde Totaaloplossing voor de SCID- en SMA-screening voor de screeningslaboratoria. Het doel van deze Europese aanbesteding is het sluiten van een Overeenkomst met één Opdrachtnemer, volgens het principe van reagent rental waarbij de leverancier eigenaar blijft van de apparatuur. De Opdrachtnemer wordt volledig verantwoordelijk voor het leveren, implementeren en doorlopend ter beschikking stellen van de Totaaloplossing en het verrichten van daaraan verwante diensten overeenkomstig de specificaties die zijn neergelegd in de Aanbestedingsstukken.

title: Netherlands – Environmental engineering consultancy services – Ondersteuning stikstofadvies, -modellering en -informatiesystemen 2027
description: Algemene informatie Aanbestedende dienst Het Rijksinstituut voor Volksgezondheid en Milieu (RIVM) is een agentschap van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (VWS). Het RIVM bevordert door onderzoek, uitvoering en ondersteuning de publieke gezondheid en een schoon en veilig leefmilieu. Tot de kerntaken van dit instituut behoort beleidsondersteuning voor de overheid. Deze diensten worden in zowel nationale als internationale context uitgevoerd. Het RIVM bestaat uit een dertigtal onderdelen, meestal laboratoria, teams of centra met een specifieke onderzoekstaak. Het domein Milieu & Veiligheid (M&V) ontwikkelt kennis en kunde en adviseert overheden over een veilige en gezonde leefomgeving. Dit domein controleert bijvoorbeeld de kwaliteit van lucht, water en bodem. En doet metingen na een ongeluk of ramp, waarbij mogelijk gevaarlijke stoffen vrijkomen. Het onderzoekt verschillende vormen van straling, zoals radioactieve stoffen, lichtbronnen, hoogspanningslijnen en mobiele telefoons. En het onderzoekt de effecten van omgevingsfactoren op de gezondheid, zoals luchtverontreiniging of geluidhinder. M&V doet ook onderzoek naar perceptie en gedrag. Als onderdeel van het domein M&V brengt Centrum Milieukwaliteit (MIL) de kwaliteit van het fysieke milieu in beeld. Het gaat dan vooral over de kwaliteit van bodem, grondwater en lucht, en van omgevingsfactoren zoals geluid en licht. Dit doet MIL door meting (monitoring) en door berekening (modellering). MIL signaleert trends en brengt de effecten van beleidsmaatregelen op de milieukwaliteit in kaart. De kwaliteit van het milieu in Nederland staat in nauwe relatie met internationale ontwikkelingen. Daarom is MIL betrokken bij de internationale milieumonitoring voor het European Environmental Agency en klimaatonderzoek. Hieronder zijn een aantal voorbeeldteksten vermeld, aanpassen aan domein / centrum / afdeling waarvoor de aanbesteding wordt uitgevoerd. Indien het een aanbesteding voor de categorie laboratorium betreft: RIVM teksten verwijderen. Indien RIVM de aanbesteding uitvoert ten behoeve van de categorie laboratorium onderstaande alinea opnemen en de namen en korte beschrijving van de opdrachtgevers vermelden (zie voor teksten het document ‘Algemene informatie deelnemers categore Lab v2’). Indien geen categorie aanbesteding, onderstaande alinea verwijderen. Aanleiding en doel van de aanbesteding De raamovereenkomst met de huidige leverancier, destijds voortgekomen uit de Europese aanbesteding AERIUS 2022 met Negometrix tendernummer 200092, dateert van november 2022 en loopt af op 14 november 2026. Een nieuwe overeenkomst voor de ondersteuning stikstofadvies en -informatiesystemen 2027 moet worden aanbesteed. Deze nieuwe Raamovereenkomst moet ingaan op 1 januari 2027. Het doel van deze Europese aanbesteding is het sluiten van een nieuwe Raamovereenkomst tussen het RIVM en één (Combinatie van) Opdrachtnemer(s) voor het aanbieden van Milieutechnische expertise en het inzetten van de stikstofinformatiesystemen van MIL, alsmede de hosting, beheer en onderhoud van de bijbehorende ICT volgens de beschrijving in dit Beschrijvend document en de Bijlagen. https://www.rivm.nl/contact/zakendoen-met-rivm

title: Norway – Hotel services – Framework agreement for course- and conference services.
description: The contracting authority is the Norwegian Labour Inspection Authority (henceforth also referred to as the Contracting Authority or the Customer). The Norwegian Labour Inspection Authority directs the commitment to target groups where the working environment needs the greatest need. The Norwegian Labour Inspection Authority consists of two entities - the Norwegian Labour Inspection Authority and the Norwegian Labour Inspection Authority's ten departments. The agency has office locations that meet entities nationwide. There are approx. 750 employees in total 22 office locations. Our employees have a regular need to gather in large or small groups outside their own offices. The framework agreement is divided into two sub areas. Sub-contracts shall be established for each sub-area for the relevant locations. Tenders are requested for: Sub area 1 • Day package ≥10 participants that include meeting rooms including technical equipment, break food and lunch, water, coffee and tea throughout the entire event. • Half day package ≥10 participants including meeting rooms, including technical equipment, water, coffee and tea throughout the entire event. Sub area 2 • Day package ≥10 participants that include meeting rooms including technical equipment, break food and lunch, water, coffee and tea throughout the entire event. • Accommodation in standard rooms including breakfast for ≥10. • Two course dinners that shall include a main course and dessert. Drink: Water, tea or coffee. • Three course dinners that shall include a starter, main course and dessert. Drink: Water, tea or coffee. See the attached tender documentation for further information.

Tavoitteena on, että sopimus tulee voimaan 10.11.2026. HANKINNAN LAAJUUS Tarjouspyynnön julkaisuhetkellä hankinnan kohteeseen sisältyy arviolta noin 67 kohdetta ja yhteensä noin 3 978 asuntoa. Kohteet ja niiden sijainnit on esitetty tarjouspyynnön liitteenä 5 olevassa kohdeluettelossa. Ilmanvaihtokanavien puhdistus suoritetaan lähtökohtaisesti kussakin kohteessa yhden kerran sopimuskauden aikana, mutta tarpeen mukaan osa kohteista voi tulla puhdistettavaksi useamman kuin yhden kerran. Kohteiden määrä voi vähäisissä määrin muuttua/lisääntyä sopimuskauden aikana. Edellä mainittujen vähäisten muutosten ei arvioida vaikuttavan merkittävästi palvelujen tuottamisen alueelliseen sijaintiin. Ks. tarkemmat tiedot hankinnan laajuudesta tarjouspyynnön liitteestä 1 "Hankinnan kohteen kuvaus" sekä liitteestä 5 "Kohdeluettelo".

title: Finland – Engineering-related scientific and technical services – HERI2 Maaperätutkimukset puitesopimus 2026-2030
description: Väylävirasto on päättänyt solmia 4-vuotisia puitesopimuksia maaperä ja pohjatutkimusten, sekä tärinä- ja melumittausten toteuttamiseksi. Hankinnan tavoitteena on mahdollistaa laadukkaan tutkimusaineiston tuottaminen tehokkaasti. Tilaaja teettää tämän puitesopimuksen perusteella seuraavia tehtäviä: Helsinki-Riihimäki kapasiteetin lisääminen 2. vaihe ja 3. vaihe, sekä Helsinki - Tampere perusparannus, projekteihin liittyvien eri suunnitteluvaiheiden ja rakentamisen aikaisten maaperä- ja pohjatutkimusten, tärinä- ja melumittausten sekä ympäristönäytteenottojen suorittaminen ja analysointi. Toimeksiannot sijaitsevat Helsinki-Tampere välillä. Edellä todetusta lähtökohdasta huolimatta puitesopimuksen mukaisia toimeksiantoja voidaan myös teettää muissa, ko. rataosuudella sopimusaikana mahdollisesti alkavissa uusissa hankkeissa. Puitejärjestelyn piirissä teetettävän työn määrä on yhteensä arviolta 750 000 euroa vuodessa ja arviolta 3 000 000 euroa puitejärjestelyn voimassaoloaikana, ilman arvonlisäveroa. Puitejärjestely solmitaan vähintään kolmen (mikäli hyväksyttyjä tarjouksia on vähemmän kuin 3 voidaan puitejärjestely solmia myös yhden tai kahden toimijan kanssa) ja enintään neljän toimittajan kanssa. Sija 4 otetaan mukaan puitejärjestelyyn, mikäli kyseisen sijan hyväksytyn tarjouksen vertailuhinnan ero halvimpaan on pienempi kuin 15 %.

title: Norway – Business and management consultancy and related services – Framework agreement for strategic management development.
description: The aim of the procurement is to cover the Norwegian Food Safety Authority ́s need for strategic management development. A year ago, the Norwegian Food Safety Authority changed the organisation from regions and traditional line to national divisions and empowered teams. We recruited over 40 new leaders, which equates to well over half of all the food safety authority leaders. The new leaders came in with different management experience and with a background from both the public and private sectors. In the process, we reduced the total number of managers, and for some managers this has resulted in a larger management span.
